Assess client environments and design secure, scalable network, server, virtualization and hybrid cloud solutions. Design and implement LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, firewall, VPN and network security solutions. Deliver server, Active Directory, virtualization, backup, disaster recovery and Azure migration projects. Perform infrastructure health and security assessments and recommend improvements to performance, resilience and lifecycle management. Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and provide escalation support to managed services teams. Automate repeatable administrative and configuration tasks to improve delivery efficiency and consistency. Facilitate client workshops, provide knowledge transfer and maintain technical documentation, including designs, diagrams and handover materials. Manage deliverables within project scope, timelines and budgets, identifying risks and changes as needed. Support solution scoping, effort estimates and statements of work for new client opportunities. Build strong client relationships and contribute to delivery standards, methodologies and leading practices. Travel to client sites approximately 25% to 30% of the time. Skills And Experience Post-secondary education in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. 3+ years of experience designing, implementing and supporting enterprise network and server infrastructure. 2+ years of consulting, professional services or project delivery experience. Experience delivering network refreshes, firewall migrations, enterprise wireless, server and virtualization upgrades, and backup and disaster recovery solutions. Strong knowledge of: Networking: Cisco, Fortinet, routing, switching, SD-WAN and enterprise wireless. Security: Fortinet FortiGate, Check Point, Cisco Meraki, firewalls, VPNs and network segmentation. Servers and virtualization: Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware vSphere and Microsoft Hyper-V. Cloud and recovery: Microsoft Azure, hybrid connectivity, Veeam, Azure Backup or similar technologies. Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, infrastructure monitoring and management tools. Firewall migrations, network refreshes, SD-WAN migrations and multi-site deployments. Cisco Meraki cloud-managed network migrations. Hypervisor, data centre, server or Azure workload migrations. Azure Virtual Desktop and Microsoft 365 migration projects. Linux administration and infrastructure patch/lifecycle management. Familiarity with Information Technology Infrastructure Library practices and formal change management. Maintain system backup and recovery procedures, perform documented restoration tests, and support execution of disaster recovery plans owned by the Manager, Infrastructure & Operations. Automation and Process Improvement Build PowerShell automation, supplemented by Bash or Python where appropriate, for provisioning, compliance validation, reporting, and routine administration. Develop repeatable, scalable processes for system deployment, configuration management, and lifecycle administration. Maintain current procedures, system documentation, runbooks, and evidence needed for operational continuity and audits. Tier 3 Escalation and Cross-Functional Support Serve as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex Microsoft 365, identity, endpoint, AWS, and server issues within the role's assigned scope. Partner with HR, Legal, Engineering, and other business functions on onboarding, offboarding, access, automation, and audit-readiness initiatives. Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, plus at least 5 years of progressive systems administration experience.
